dialogues.speaker: Flight Trial Notice
dialogues.text: "All candidates wishing to take part in the flight test must first clear mental aptitude and physical examinations before being allowed to practice take-offs."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Trial Notice
dialogues.text: "Meanwhile, all flight-related training must be conducted under the protection and supervision of a tutor. Any unauthorized training will result in permanent loss of eligibility for flight trials."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Trial Notice
dialogues.text: "Administrators reserve the right to terminate any training currently underway, and if a termination signal is received, please follow all instructions in returning to the arena."
